description: Gearshift chooses the model and reasoning effort for subagent spawns using the OpenAI Decisions API under the user's own API key. SessionStart adds a fixed note telling the agent how to delegate so routing applies. PreToolUse is synchronous and may add model and reasoning_effort to spawn_agent arguments; it changes nothing else unless convert_full_forks is enabled. PostToolUse records the spawn. UserPromptSubmit does nothing unless the user turns on include_user_prompt. Every hook exits 0 on any failure and none can block a prompt or a spawn.

hooks.statusMessage: Gearshift is choosing a model for this subagent
